query: Marvell data center revenue most recent quarter

output.content: Marvell’s most recently reported data-center revenue was **$2.172 billion** in **Q2 fiscal 2027** (three months ended **August 1, 2026**), representing **46% year-over-year** and **18% sequential** growth; data center accounted for **79%** of total revenue. [[1]]

sources.title: Marvell Technology, Inc. Reports Second Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results
